verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a homepage claim of "token exchange, and agent delegation" for AI agents. The MCP plugin lets the app act as an OAuth authorization server for MCP clients, but that issues tokens for your own app rather than vaulting or exchanging tokens for third-party APIs. missing for 10: documentation of a token vault or exchange flow for third-party API tokens, short-lived token issuance, a user-consent flow for delegated access, an agent-side retrieval API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent obtain short-lived, user-consented tokens for third-party APIs (token vault/exchange) so tool calls run under the user's delegated authority

citations.quote: Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation.
The **MCP** plugin lets your app act as an OAuth authorization server and protected resource for [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) clients.
